description: This file defines the BrowseViewModel class for managing recipe data, filtering, and UI state in an Android TV app. It handles loading recipes, applying filters, and toggling favorites, utilizing Kotlin coroutines and StateFlow for reactive data handling.

classes.name: BrowseViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel managing recipe data, filters, and UI state for the browsing screen.

classes.name: BrowseUiState
classes.description: Sealed class representing different UI states: Loading, Empty, Success, Error.

classes.name: FilterType
classes.description: Sealed class representing filter options: All, Favorites, and Cuisine.

methods.name: loadRecipes
methods.description: Loads recipes based on the current filter, updating UI state accordingly.

methods.name: loadCuisines
methods.description: Loads available cuisine types from the repository.

methods.name: applyFilter
methods.description: Sets the selected filter and reloads recipes.

methods.name: toggleFavorite
methods.description: Toggles the favorite status of a recipe by its ID.
